scope: documentation/evidence only, not C0 completion or implementation acceptance

checks.gitDiffWhitespace: passed for authored documentation/evidence code/JSON; raw logs checked separately and preserved byte-for-byte
checks.rawLogsWhitespace: trailing whitespace emitted by test runner is retained; whole-diff whitespace check reports those raw log lines, not a clean global check

limits: No Markdown anchor resolver or execution of future goal examples
No runtime/config-suite rerun for documentation edits
Manifest generation verified mechanically by main agent, not new semantic subagent acceptance
Remote confirmation occurs after commit/push and is not implied here

preliminaryValidationFailure.reason: main-agent validation initially compared a preserved historical reviewer hash for config-definition instead of the final readback hash
preliminaryValidationFailure.resolution: verify final independent addendum identity; preserve historical reviewer evidence; include originally Git-ignored raw logs explicitly
